purpose: Teach: 招聘/来賓/一報/区役所/登用/譲り/心掛け/御礼

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業期、本気で、絶対、海外、絶対、招聘、絶対、技師、絶対、迎えたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When I was starting out, I made it a point to bring skilled engineers from overseas. I asked them earnestly, with everything I had.
lines.style: Measured, reflective opening. Slight pause after the name. Soft conviction on the memory—not bragging, just stating what mattered then. Quiet pride woven through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの、本気で、絶対、来賓、絶対、対応、絶対、見習っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've tried to follow your example with how you treated those visiting partners—the care you showed them. I'm grateful for that.
lines.style: Quiet, direct acknowledgment. Weight on 「見習っております」—not casual deference but genuine learned respect. Steady eye contact. Slower pace, each word deliberate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、大事な、絶対、契約、絶対、一報、絶対、必ず、絶対、伝えてくれたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And whenever something important came up—a contract, news that mattered—you always made sure I heard it first. You never cut me out.
lines.style: Softer now, almost confessional. A small catch in the voice on the memory of inclusion. Trailing off gently, as if he's still feeling the significance of being trusted.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、区役所、絶対、と、絶対、地域貢献、絶対、進めた、絶対、お話、絶対、伺っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I remember how you worked with the ward office, how you built those community partnerships. I try to carry that forward.
lines.style: Thoughtful, grounded tone. Nodding slightly in the voice. Speaking from a place of understanding earned over time, not recitation. Warm but steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、若手、絶対、登用、絶対、推進、絶対、なさったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: You pushed to promote younger people—to give them their chance. That took real conviction.
lines.style: Softer, almost wondering. The voice of someone looking back and seeing something they didn't fully grasp at the time. Pause between phrases. Quiet reverence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんから、本気で、絶対、譲り、絶対、受けた、絶対、お得意様、絶対、大切にしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've inherited what you trusted me with—those important clients, those relationships. I treat them with the same care you showed.
lines.style: Steady resolve. Clear commitment in the voice. Not hesitant—he knows this is what he carries forward. Slight emphasis on inherited responsibility, not burden.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、商売の、絶対、心掛け、絶対、いつも、絶対、誠実だったぞ、本気for、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The way you approached business was always rooted in sincerity. That was constant with you.
lines.style: Warm, almost tender observation. Slow pace. The voice of someone who watched this lived daily and understood it. Trailing thought, like he's still reflecting on how deep it went.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、お客様への、絶対、御礼、絶対、絶対欠かさなかった、絶対、姿勢、絶対、引き継いでおります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That matters to me most—how you never forgot to thank the people you worked with. That's what I hold onto.
lines.style: Quiet closing. Soft but firm. The voice settles into gratitude without sentimentality. A gentle exhale at the very end, as if completing something important.
